# Configuration

Every key Planroom reads, with its default. You can set a key in two optional files of one schema:

- your user-level `${XDG_CONFIG_HOME:-$HOME/.config}/planroom/config.toml`;
- a workspace's `config.toml` in its state directory (`.planroom/`, or `.git/planroom/` when the workspace is one repo), which loads only once you trust the workspace.

A workspace's file wins over yours, and a variable wins over both. A list variable takes TOML array syntax, `["a", "b"]`, or comma-separated values.

**Where** says which file may set the key. `user` keys are credential settings and limits across every workspace: a workspace's file never sets one, and Planroom ignores it there with the warning `config_key_ignored`. `api_key` counts only in a file of mode 0600.

| Key | Where | Default | Variable | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `packs` | workspace | `[]` | none | Extra pack directories, after the built-ins. `planroom pack add` and `pack remove` write it, and no variable overrides it, since the pack set is workspace state (DR-62). |
| `models` | either | `"auto"` | `PLANROOM_MODELS` | `auto`, or `off` to turn every Jev and Claude call off: deterministic tiers, defaults and pre-selected cards. |
| `[scan] exclude` | either | `["**/fixture/**", "**/fixtures/**", "**/__fixtures__/**", "**/testdata/**", "**/test-data/**"]` | `PLANROOM_SCAN_EXCLUDE` | Directories a scan skips, as globs relative to each repo's root. Your value replaces this list, and the list is part of each snapshot's key (DR-89). |
| `[claude] backend` | user | `"auto"` | `PLANROOM_CLAUDE_BACKEND` | `auto` (the gateway if a credential resolves, else your session if a mod is attached, else off), `gateway`, `session` or `off`. |
| `[claude] base_url` | user, no variable | `"https://ai-gateway.vercel.sh"` | none | The gateway's base URL. A credential goes only to this host, `ai-gateway.vercel.sh` or `api.typesafe.ai`. Only your user-level file sets it, never a variable, so a process that can set your environment can't send your key elsewhere. |
| `[claude] api_key_env` | user | `"AI_GATEWAY_API_KEY"` | `PLANROOM_CLAUDE_API_KEY_ENV` | The name of the variable that holds the gateway key: `AI_GATEWAY_API_KEY`, `VERCEL_OIDC_TOKEN` or `TYPESAFE_API_KEY`. |
| `[claude] api_key` | user, mode 0600 | none | none | The gateway key itself, if you keep it in your user-level file rather than the environment. It is ignored unless the file is mode 0600, and no variable overrides it. |
| `[claude] model_cheap` | either | `"anthropic/claude-haiku-5.5"` | `PLANROOM_CLAUDE_MODEL_CHEAP` | The pinned model ID for cheap calls. |
| `[claude] model_capable` | either | `"anthropic/claude-sonnet-5.5"` | `PLANROOM_CLAUDE_MODEL_CAPABLE` | The pinned model ID for capable calls. |
| `[claude] providers` | either | `["anthropic"]` | `PLANROOM_CLAUDE_PROVIDERS` | The gateway providers Claude calls may use (`providerOptions.gateway.only`). |
| `[jev] backend` | user | `"gateway"` | `PLANROOM_JEV_BACKEND` | `gateway` or `typesafe`. |
| `[jev] model` | either | `"typesafe-ai/jev-1.14.0"` | `PLANROOM_JEV_MODEL` | The pinned Jev model ID: `jev-1.14.0`, or `jev-latest` on the direct API. |
| `[budget] jev_per_scan_usd` | either | `0.001` | `PLANROOM_BUDGET_JEV_PER_SCAN_USD` | Dollars of Jev calls per `scan` event and per explicit `decide --run` (DR-65). |
| `[budget] claude_per_day_usd` | user | `1.0` | `PLANROOM_BUDGET_CLAUDE_PER_DAY_USD` | Real dollars of gateway and TypeSafe calls per day, across every workspace, from `DATA_ROOT/ledger.db` (DR-65). |
| `[budget] live_tests_total_usd` | user | `3.0` | `PLANROOM_BUDGET_LIVE_TESTS_TOTAL_USD` | The cap on the total of `PLANROOM_SPEND_LOG`, less a $0.25 margin (DR-65). |
